title: The Toronto book group met, and left with a plan — 'rallying around founders building incorruptible, purpose-locked businesses, and pioneering new structures in Canada'
summary: Five weeks after Natasha Freidus posted 'Who else is reading this?' halfway through the book, the group she was asking for met in person at Aldo de Jong's apartment — founders, employees, investors, board members, policy and non-profit people from Waterloo to the Beaches. Kris Braun writes that his fear was a polite arm's-length discussion; what happened instead was creative disagreement with the book and with each other, and a decision to organise. They have started a WhatsApp group and are trying to gauge how many people in Canada want to build or convert businesses to steward ownership and mission locks.
blockquote: The biggest surprise was where we ended up. Not just interest in further discussion, but concrete action: rallying around founders building incorruptible, purpose-locked businesses, and pioneering new structures in Canada rather than defaulting to the way it’s always been done.
